description: A friendly snowman made from three rounded snowballs stacked on top of one another: a wide base, a smaller middle, and a round head. The body is slightly lumpy and uneven, as though packed by hand from soft snow. Thin stick arms extend from the sides. The face is broad and cheerful, with dark coal eyes, a smiling coal mouth, and a long carrot nose pointing outward. A tall black top hat sits on the head, giving the otherwise soft, rounded silhouette a distinctive, playful outline.
